_what: Where the sound that moves things comes from. Each row is one source a person can pick: its words, its icon, and how the browser opens it (`opens`: `microphone` asks for the microphone, `screen-sound` asks to share a tab or the whole screen with its sound, `page-media` listens to whatever plays in Trillion itself). A new source the browser can open is one row here and, only when it needs a new way of opening, one opener in sound-signal.ts. `bands` are the low, middle and high ranges the sound is split into, in Hz; `beat` says how much louder than its recent average the low band must get to count as a beat, and how long to wait before the next one.
